title: Managed Backup: remittance order
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines remittance order.

## Tier basis

**Default remittance allocation order.** Default allocation of an unspecified remittance; deterministic string.

| Contract tier | Default remittance allocation order |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | Invoice issue time followed by original source reference |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | Invoice issue time followed by original source reference |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | Invoice issue time followed by original source reference |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | Invoice issue time followed by original source reference |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | Invoice issue time followed by original source reference |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | Invoice issue time followed by original source reference |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, default remittance allocation order is Invoice issue time followed by original source reference.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, default remittance allocation order stays the same.
